metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: panes, bands and hooks that run inside the terminal and the desktop app

plugins.name: build-monitor
plugins.description: A pane that opens by itself when Claude runs a build (Xcode, Gradle, SwiftPM, fastlane, Flutter, React Native): a timer, failed tests and errors, Ask Claude to fix, and the build's trend

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: A side pane listing the repository's GitHub issues, with one click to have Claude work on one
